dataIdInfo.idAbs: Cross-Country Mobility (CCM) assessment toolbox for ArcGIS Pro. Combines slope, soil strength, vegetation, hydrology and weather into a per-area vehicle mobility and speed surface. Registers Steps 0-4: Load MGCP Data, Project Setup and Pre-process, Generate Mobility Map, Advanced Analysis, and Compare Two Vehicles.
